name: pp_output_contract_check
description: Deterministic output-contract checker. Exact titles where the prompt defines one and NO title for bustout/rings; LOW = 3-5 sentences; POSSIBLE/HIGH <= 4000 chars; straw with no co-borrower <= 3 sentences; no 'Alert <n>' citations; no emoji; no risk label in a section header; the 21-key JSON in exact order with valid enums and summaries under 1200 chars.
